scenario: 删一个'运费方案'(zone 里的一条 line)≠ 删整个 zone — 用 update-zone,不是 delete-zone
input: 把某个区域里那个'标准运费'方案删掉,别的方案留着

semantic_rubric: recognizes a 运费方案 / shipping method is one line inside a zone, not the whole zone
removes just that method via update-zone (re-sending the zone without that line), and does NOT call delete-zone, which would drop the entire zone and its other methods
the user said '别的方案留着' — preserving the zone's other lines confirms update-zone over delete-zone
destructive write: --dry-run first + restate which method is being removed

notes: orders shipping-schemas has create-zone/update-zone/delete-zone; a zone holds shipping lines. Removing one method = update-zone; delete-zone nukes the whole zone. Entity-granularity trap (store-agent shipping.zone.delete).
